video_description: Two young women sit side-by-side on the edge of a bed covered with a blue blanket.
The woman in the beige top speaks to her companion in a concerned tone.
The woman in the cream sweater holds the other woman's hands consolingly.
The woman in the cream sweater speaks reassuringly, suggesting they consult a robot.
She then turns her head forward toward the camera and calls out to activate the robot.
high_level_conclusions: The woman in the beige top is anxious about being scolded by someone.
The woman in the cream sweater acts as a comforting friend offering emotional support.
They intend to interact with a smart device or robotic assistant for guidance or distraction.
